tasks.goal: Show your passport
tasks.hint: You need to prove your identity. Present your passport.

tasks.goal: Declare all luggage contents
tasks.hint: You must report items. List everything in your bags.
tasks.done_when: Learner declared their luggage contents.

tasks.goal: State your purpose of visit
tasks.hint: You need to explain why you're traveling. Say your reason.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated their purpose of visit.

tasks.goal: Ask for a customs form
tasks.hint: You need to fill out paperwork. Request the required form.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a customs form.

tasks.goal: Confirm your flight details
tasks.hint: You need to verify your arrival. Share your flight information.

tasks.goal: Negotiate a delay due to system issues

tasks.goal: Explain a prohibited item's purpose

tasks.goal: Dispute a denied item without arguing
tasks.hint: Your item was rejected. Politely question the decision.

tasks.goal: Weigh a cultural trade-off out loud

tasks.goal: Ask for a receipt after customs

tasks.goal: Report a lost item in the customs area
tasks.hint: You need to file a report. Describe the missing item.

tasks.goal: Request a delay for a security alert

tasks.goal: Negotiate a missing document

tasks.goal: Ask for a language interpreter

tasks.goal: Confirm your visa status

tasks.goal: Complain about a denied item
tasks.hint: Your item was rejected. Politely question the decision.

tasks.goal: Ask for a stamp on your passport
tasks.hint: You need to mark your entry. Request a customs stamp.

tasks.goal: Report a security threat

tasks.goal: Negotiate a late arrival

tasks.goal: Ask for a customs inspection

tasks.goal: Confirm your luggage weight

tasks.goal: Negotiate a prohibited item's return

tasks.goal: Ask for a customs form in another language
tasks.hint: You need to fill out paperwork. Request a translated form.

tasks.goal: Report a customs error

tasks.goal: Confirm your baggage claim details

tasks.goal: Negotiate a late customs clearance
tasks.hint: Your luggage is delayed. Explain the situation and request a timeline.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained the delay AND requested a timeline for clearance.

tasks.goal: Ask for a customs stamp on your luggage
tasks.hint: You need to mark your luggage. Request a customs stamp.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a luggage customs stamp.

tasks.goal: Confirm your arrival time
tasks.hint: You need to know when to arrive. Share the scheduled time.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed their arrival time.

tasks.goal: Negotiate a denied item's replacement
tasks.hint: Your item was rejected. Propose a substitute or explanation.
tasks.done_when: Learner acknowledged the denied item AND proposed a replacement.

tasks.goal: Ask for a customs inspection of a specific item
tasks.hint: You need to check a specific item. Request a targeted inspection.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a customs inspection of a specific item.

tasks.goal: Confirm your luggage's destination
tasks.hint: You need to verify your bags' destination. Share the details.

tasks.goal: Negotiate a customs delay for a connecting flight
tasks.hint: Your flight is delayed. Explain the situation and request leniency.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained the delay AND requested leniency for a connecting flight.

tasks.goal: Ask for a customs inspection of a liquid
tasks.hint: You need to check a liquid item. Request a targeted inspection.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a customs inspection of a liquid.

tasks.goal: Confirm your luggage's weight limit
tasks.hint: You need to verify your bag's weight. Share the total.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed their luggage's weight limit.

tasks.goal: Negotiate a denied item's return with a refund
tasks.hint: Your item was confiscated. Request its return and compensation.

tasks.goal: Ask for a customs form with specific instructions

tasks.goal: Confirm your customs clearance time
tasks.hint: You need to know when your luggage will be processed. Share the estimated time.

tasks.goal: Negotiate a customs delay for a medical item
tasks.hint: Your item is for medical use. Explain the situation and request leniency.

tasks.goal: Ask for a customs inspection of a food item
tasks.hint: You need to check a food item. Request a targeted inspection.

tasks.goal: Confirm your luggage's contents with a receipt
tasks.hint: You need to prove your luggage's contents. Show the receipt.

tasks.goal: Declare duty-free goods bought at airport departure

tasks.scene_hint: A heavy conveyor belt hums beside a row of stainless steel border desks.

tasks.goal: State duration of stay for entry validation
tasks.hint: Inform the officer how many days or weeks you plan to stay in the country.
tasks.done_when: Learner stated the length of their planned stay.
tasks.scene_hint: Overhead monitors flicker with international flight arrivals and gate numbers.

tasks.goal: Report cash amount exceeding currency entry thresholds
tasks.hint: Inform the officer that you are carrying currency above the declaration limit.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported carrying cash over the legal threshold.
tasks.scene_hint: Acrylic glass partitions reflect the queue of arriving international travelers.

tasks.goal: Explain presence of commercial product samples in baggage
tasks.hint: Clarify that extra merchandise in your suit bag is for business demonstration.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained that items in baggage are commercial samples.
tasks.scene_hint: Officers in crisp blue uniforms inspect open suitcases on steel tables.

tasks.goal: Present sealed medical prescription for controlled medication
tasks.hint: Show doctor documentation for prescription drugs in your carry-on.
tasks.done_when: Learner presented prescription documentation for medication.
tasks.scene_hint: Red and green entry channels segment passenger lines under bright fluorescent lamps.

tasks.goal: Request secondary inspection room privacy for sensitive items
tasks.hint: Ask to have personal or valuable belongings inspected in a private area.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a private room for customs inspection.
tasks.scene_hint: Stanchions with black woven ribbons guide passengers toward border kiosks.

tasks.goal: Clarify agricultural declaration for packaged dried spices
tasks.hint: Explain that sealed culinary herbs in your luggage are commercially processed.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained the packaged nature of declared food items.
tasks.scene_hint: Sniffer dogs on leashes walk along rows of stacked travel bags.

tasks.goal: Appeal an unexpected customs duty charge on personal gifts
tasks.hint: Politely contest an assessed tariff by proving items are used personal effects.
tasks.done_when: Learner contested a customs duty assessment on personal effects.
tasks.scene_hint: Barcode scanners beep as officers log declared import valuations.

tasks.goal: Explain missing origin certificate for handcrafted wooden souvenirs

tasks.done_when: Learner addressed the lack of an origin certificate for wooden goods.
tasks.scene_hint: A large digital sign displays restricted import categories in six languages.

tasks.goal: Negotiate temporary storage for over-limit duty items
tasks.hint: Ask if unpaid duty goods can be held securely until your departure flight.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated temporary airport storage for uncleared goods.
tasks.scene_hint: Clear acrylic counter guards separate border agents from arriving passengers.

tasks.goal: Dispute suspicion of commercial intent for personal electronics
tasks.hint: Convince the inspector that two laptops are for personal work, not resale.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified personal use for multiple electronic devices.
tasks.scene_hint: X-ray scanners hum silently as baggage passes through rubber curtains.

tasks.goal: Request written justification for confiscated agricultural products
tasks.hint: Ask the customs agent for an official document stating why food items were seized.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested written documentation for confiscated items.
tasks.scene_hint: Yellow biohazard bins stand near the primary inspection stations.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'dutiable'
tasks.hint: Dutiable means subject to customs tax or import duty. Ask if your commercial gifts are considered dutiable.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'dutiable'.
tasks.scene_hint: Official tax schedule charts hang on the wall behind the supervisor desk.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'documentation'
tasks.hint: Documentation refers to official paperwork required for verification. Inquire about the necessary customs clearance documentation.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'documentation'.
tasks.scene_hint: Stamps press firmly onto blue official entry logbooks.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'routing'
tasks.hint: Routing refers to the designated path or schedule for cargo transit. Ask about the international shipment routing plan.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'routing'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'prohibition'
tasks.hint: Prohibition refers to legal bans on importing specific items. Inquire if agricultural goods fall under prohibition.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'prohibition'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'consular'
tasks.hint: Consular relates to official embassy seals and visa verifications. Present your consular entry clearance stamp.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'consular'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about tax refund authorization at customs exit
tasks.hint: Ask the officer to validate export tax refund forms for goods leaving the country.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about tax refund validation at exit.

tasks.goal: Confirm entry requirements for accompanied domestic pets
tasks.hint: Provide veterinary health clearance papers for your pet.
tasks.done_when: Learner presented pet health documentation to customs.

tasks.goal: Clarify allowance limits for imported tea or coffee
tasks.hint: Ask the officer how many kilograms of tea can be brought in without tax.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about tax-free weight limits for tea or coffee.

tasks.goal: Report broken seal on duty-free liquid bag
tasks.hint: Explain to the officer that security tamper tape tore during transit.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported a compromised duty-free security bag seal.

tasks.goal: Request guidance on filling out paper arrival card
tasks.hint: Ask the desk agent how to complete the baggage valuation section.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help completing the arrival declaration card.

tasks.goal: Verify return procedure for bonded luggage in transit
tasks.hint: Ask where to collect held transit bags before boarding your next flight.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about retrieving bonded luggage in transit.

tasks.goal: Ask officer to re-scan passport microchip
tasks.hint: Request a manual scan after an automated gate reader fails.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked officer to re-scan passport chip manually.

tasks.goal: Obtain stamped customs clearance slip before exit gates
tasks.hint: Ask the border agent for your physical release slip to show exit security.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested stamped customs exit release slip.

tasks.goal: Ask location of airport payment counter for assessed import tax
tasks.hint: Find out where to pay duty fees using cash or credit card.

tasks.goal: Confirm luggage handover to domestic baggage transfer counter
tasks.hint: Verify that cleared bags will automatically transfer to your domestic connection.

tasks.goal: Request copy of signed customs inspection log
tasks.hint: Ask officer for a duplicate receipt listing all checked items.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a copy of the inspection report.

tasks.goal: Thank customs officer and inquire about terminal exit direction
tasks.hint: Politely conclude the clearance check and ask how to reach the arrival hall.
